adjudication.rationale: The locale string added in config/locales/server.en.yml says `feed_polling_enabled` is "Whether to import a RSS/ATOM feed as posts", but the diff shows feed polling calls `TopicEmbed.import(...)` (app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb), which creates a new *topic* (via `PostCreator.new(user, title: title, ...)` in app/models/topic_embed.rb) per feed item and later revises the existing first post in that topic when `content_sha1` changes. This is a documentation/wording mismatch, not a functional defect.
